known_limitations: Implements a compact MVP focused on core capture, trace, compare, audit, and export flows rather than every interview requirement in full depth.
Role and sensitivity handling are simplified and driven by environment variables instead of a full authentication and authorization subsystem.
Exports are JSON or CSV only; PDF/Word generation is not implemented.
Validation is structural only and does not perform deep semantic policy analysis.
Persistence uses a single JSON file and is suitable for lightweight use rather than high-concurrency production deployment.
